## Experience
- **Independent Consultant, Technical & Delivery Advisory** · Freelance · Jan 2025 – Present. Technical guidance across Python, Kotlin, PHP and .NET, focused on application performance and architecture; kept current on Azure, GCP and AI development tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot).
- **Software Development Coordinator (Delivery Manager & Scrum Master)** · LSEG · Oct 2022 – Dec 2024. A release every three weeks for a global team of 15 to 20 with no rollbacks; owned change management and release governance (preparation, risk analysis, verification, rollback planning) through GitHub pipelines and ServiceNow approvals; coordinated the move of the .NET workload from AWS to Azure without taking production down; Scrum Master; designed and ran hiring interviews for analysts, testers and developers; earlier in the role led the local developers and built the ListAPI module of a Portfolio Management platform, shipped on time (Clean Architecture, CQRS).
- **Software Developer, Delivery & Implementation** · Qualysoft · Oct 2020 – Sep 2022. Coordinated the implementation of one module of a GPS tracking solution; improved development workflows and delivery processes; supported project planning and effort estimation.
- **Software Development Team Coordinator** · Yokogawa · Jan 2019 – May 2020. Started the software team from nothing (role profiles, hiring, Azure DevOps, CI/CD); introduced Agile to stakeholders; standardised requirements, user stories, delivery procedures and stakeholder communication; mentored and onboarded the team.
- **Corporate Team-building Facilitator (part-time)** · Ascendis · Jan 2010 – Dec 2018. Group activities, professional events and debriefs for corporate groups.
- **Software Engineer** · ORTEC · Mar 2018 – Sep 2018. C#/ASP.NET integration on Exact Synergy; functional specifications.
- **Technical Lead, Automation Engineering Platforms** · Yokogawa · Aug 2011 – Jun 2017. Technical leadership combined with business analysis and stakeholder work for industrial automation; agreed interoperability and data-transfer standards with Siemens, WAGO, ABB and Evonik (the target was 80% less effort to migrate an industrial automation project between platforms); ran Yokogawa's booth and workshops at the NAMUR Global Assembly 2016 (500+ attendees); NAMUR Modular Production prototype integrated into Centum VP; business analysis in Japan, the Netherlands and Germany; code reviews, QA procedures, planning, mentoring.
- **Software Developer, Business Analysis & Project Coordination** · INTRAROM · Aug 2007 – Jul 2011. Business-flow analysis, requirements, planning and delivery of enterprise applications: railway ticketing (Windows Mobile) for the national railway company, internal production systems, SharePoint intranet; accounting modules for CIEL Romania (2010).
- **Software Developer** · Various Companies · Dec 2005 – Jul 2007. Lemonbyte (BPM platform, ASP/VB to C#/ASP.NET, Windows Workflow engine), Axes Software (Reporting Services, WMS modules, wireless LAN), Gameloft (testing and bug reporting, technical documentation).
